capabilities: Add an Eisenhower matrix view to a Base
Drag cards between quadrants to write boolean properties to frontmatter
Toggle a done property on cards without opening the note
Show read-only property badges and stagnation indicators on cards
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true; touch support planned). Requires Obsidian 1.12.0+ with the Bases core plugin enabled. Free and open source (MIT) with GitHub Sponsors and Ko-fi donation links. v1 supports boolean axes only; numeric and tag axes are under consideration. Community plugin listing was pending at time of writing. Interface supports Auto/English/Japanese.
intentEvidence: A perspective the built-in Bases views (table / cards / kanban) can't give
problem: Obsidian's built-in Bases views (table, cards, kanban) cannot show notes on two priority axes with in-place, persisted reclassification by drag and drop.
summary: Custom Bases view that shows notes as a 2x2 Eisenhower matrix (urgency x importance) and writes quadrant changes back to note frontmatter.
